title: Rabbi Shalom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Shalom. (Shallum son of Jabesh, king of Israel, II Kings 15:13). He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 34:9, saying in the name of Rabbi Menachema son of Rabbi Ze'ira.
Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 24, reads that he spoke in the name of Rabbi Acha son of Rabbi Zeira; in both passages the intended name is Ahavah son of Rabbi Zeira.
We also find Rabbi Yehudah HaLevi bar Shalom, well known in the midrashim. Bamidbar Rabbah 15:46 has Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi bar Shalom; it should read Rabbi Yehudah HaLevi bar Shalom.
Likewise the old Tanchuma, 72, has Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Shalom; it should read Rabbi Yehudah, as in Tanchuma Buber.

notes.text: The Biblical Shallum is a namesake. Menachema, Acha and Ahavah are Hyman’s reported forms; his proposed corrections are not silently imposed on a primary text. The final notation 72 is retained without deciding whether it labels a page or a numbered division.

The entire consulted Midrash Rabbah—TE Bereshit Rabbah 34:9 directly names Rav Shalom in the name of Rabbi Menachma bar Zeira. Hyman’s Rabbi heading, Menachema form, Ahavah/Acha reconstruction and proposed Yehudah HaLevi corrections in other works remain attributed separately; the Biblical Shallum is only a namesake.
